experiments.title: Education admission
experiments.description: Inspect the signed response to one authorized read of a fictional student support record.
experiments.scope: One student · one approved support read

tamper.description: The response changes from scheduled-check-in to immediate-follow-up. The signed response digest stays the same.

experiments.title: Financial intent
experiments.description: Check the target’s original receipt for a fictional CAD 45.00 payment intent. The recorded disposition is pending.
experiments.scope: One account · one pending payment intent

tamper.description: The amount changes from 4,500 to 4,600 minor units. The original grant, receipt and expected amount stay fixed.

experiments.title: Historical audit
experiments.description: Inspect an auditor’s separately authorized disclosure of an archived, pending fictional payment intent.

tamper.description: The inquiry presents a different challenge. The auditor’s proof and the independently supplied challenge stay fixed.

conditions.title: Education admission
conditions.detail: The target receipt, owner grant, caller, qualification and fictional response match the published expectations at admission.

conditions.title: Financial intent
conditions.detail: The original target signature binds the amount, payee, request and pending disposition.

conditions.title: Historical disclosure
conditions.detail: The original intent and disclosure have separate authorization records, signatures, challenges and signed times.

conditions.title: Altered evidence
conditions.detail: The canonical verifier rejects each of the three specified substitutions against its original inputs.

conditions.title: Cross-UID custody
conditions.detail: The published trials used one Linux UID. Independent key and archive custody need a two-account demonstration.

conditions.title: Independent witness custody
conditions.detail: The samples include witness signatures. The reviewer still trusts the distribution and retention of the public pins.

conditions.title: Current revocation and replay state
conditions.detail: The portable disclosure omits an independently retained commitment to current revocations and consumed challenges.

conditions.title: Coordinated rollback
conditions.detail: Restoring the ledger, its retained head and external references together is outside these trials.

conditions.title: Storage power loss
conditions.detail: The inherited crash controls exercise process death. A sudden loss of host power was not tested.

conditions.title: Real financial settlement
conditions.detail: The ordinary audit returns settlement UNESTABLISHED. The preview includes no settlement authority or transfer service.

conditions.title: Production confinement
conditions.detail: Independent measurements for the full runtime and all resource paths remain outstanding.

conditions.title: Production operation
conditions.detail: The experiments use fixed local synthetic resources and an operator-provisioned trust root.

conditions.title: Formal certification
conditions.detail: This preview carries no formal certification.
